configurations.name: ran-app
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; exec npx vite --port 5183 --strictPort --configLoader=runner

configurations.name: dcos-ops
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; cd ../dcos-ops/app && exec npx vite --port 5181 --strictPort
